verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Banking-as-a-Service docs describe programmatically creating accounts with local bank details in 60+ markets for your customers, letting them hold funds in 20 currencies and convert FX. Connected accounts and customer onboarding are also programmatic, which delivers the core embedded-accounts capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation that Airwallex's own licensing or regulatory coverage removes the need for the developer to hold a financial license, detail on KYC/onboarding requirements for end customers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
